name: StartupFlow AI 2.0
tagline: Find startup credits you actually qualify for.
maker_comment_excerpt: The worst email a founder gets isn't a "no". It's "we only accept US-incorporated companies," after you spent your evening on the application. Hi Product Hunt 👋 That email is why we built StartupFlow AI, and today we're back with 2.0. It finds the cloud credits, AI credits and accelerators you actually qualify for: 🧭 Rules first, AI second.
